in_arabic.name: بشر
in_arabic.meaning: بشر تعني الخبر السار او البشارة
in_arabic.long_meaning: بشر هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و معناه الخبر السار، البشارة، الفرح، السرور، و يأتي من جذر الفعل 'بشر' الذي يعني الإعلام بالخير و الفرح. ورد ذكر البشر في القرآن الكريم كإعلام بالخير و السعادة.

in_urdu.name: بشر
in_urdu.meaning: بشر کا مطلب خوشخبری یا اچھے خبر
in_urdu.long_meaning: بشر ایک عربی मूल کا مذکر نام ہے جس کا مطلب خوشخبری، اچھے خبر، فرح، یا سرور ہے۔ یہ نام عربی جڑوں سے ماخوذ ہے، خاص طور پر فعل 'بشر' سے جس کا مطلب اچھے خبر دینا یا فرح کا اعلان کرنا ہے۔ اسلامی تقویم میں بشر کے نام کی اہمیت اس کے فرح و مسرت کے معنی سے منسلک ہے۔

in_hindi.name: बुशर
in_hindi.meaning: बुशर का अर्थ है खुशखबरी या अच्छे खबर
in_hindi.long_meaning: बुशर एक अरबी मूल का पुल्लिंग नाम है जिसका अर्थ है खुशखबरी, अच्छे खबर, आनंद या हर्ष। यह नाम अरबी जड़ों से लिया गया है, विशेष रूप से क्रिया 'बशर' से जिसका अर्थ है अच्छे खबर देना या हर्ष का घोषणा करना। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में बुशर नाम का महत्व इसकी हर्ष और आनंद के अर्थ से जुड़ा है।

in_pashto.name: بشر
in_pashto.long_meaning: بشر د عربي اصل مذکر نوم دی چه د ښه خبرې، خوشخبري، خوښۍ، يا خوشحالۍ معنی ورکوي. دا نوم د عربي ريښو څخه اخيستل شوی دی، په ځانګړي ډول د 'بشر' فعل څخه چې د ښه خبرې ورکولو يا خوښۍ اعلان کولو معنی لري. په افغان او پښتون دود کې بشر نوم د هغې خوښۍ او خوشحالۍ د مفهوم سره تړلی اهمیت لري.

in_english.name: Busr
in_english.long_meaning: Busr is a masculine given name of Arabic origin, meaning good news, glad tidings, joy, or happiness. Etymologically, it derives from the Arabic root 'b-sh-r' which signifies bringing or receiving good news. In Islamic tradition, the name Busr holds significance as it relates to the announcement of joy and happiness. Historically, it has been used across various Muslim cultures, symbolizing positive tidings and cheerfulness. The name Busr is associated with personality traits such as being optimistic, joyful, and a bringer of happiness to others.

data.cultural_impact: The name Busr is of Arabic origin and has significant cultural impact in the Islamic community. It is a name that connotes strength, courage, and success. In Islamic tradition, Busr is a surname commonly used to denote military valor and achievement. For instance, during the early Islamic caliphate, there was a famous soldier named Busr ibn Artat, who was renowned for his bravery and battlefield victories. Thus, the name Busr has become a badge of honor and pride for Muslim families with a martial lineage.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Busr signifies the inner strength and fortitude required to overcome challenges and obstacles in life. It serves as a reminder of the importance of courage, faith, and determination during adversity. The name Busr also reflects the belief that success and triumph come through the blessings and guidance of Allah (SWT). Thus, it is an inspiring name that symbolizes the aspiration to be a true believer and servant of Allah, and to strive for success and strength through faith and struggle.

historical_references.reference: Busr ibn Abi Artah was a prominent companion and a close friend of the Prophet Muhammad. He participated in many battles and was known for his bravery and loyalty. One of his most significant contributions was leading the victory procession when the Islamic forces conquered Damascus in 634 CE.

Busr ibn Arit Ka'ab al-Aslami was a nobleman and a leader of the Berber tribes in North Africa during the time of the Rashidun Caliphate. He rebelled against the Muslim rule and led a series of uprisings between 689 and 692 CE. Despite his military prowess, he was eventually defeated and executed.

modern_usage.modern_context: Busr ibn Artat, also known as Khalid ibn al-Walid al-Taymi, was an early Muslim military leader and one of the first converts to Islam. He is considered to be one of the greatest military commanders in Islamic history. In modern context, his name is increasingly mentioned in discussions related to Islamic history, Arabic culture, and historical figures on various social media platforms like Twitter, Instagram, and Reddit. Users often share information, quotes, and stories about Busr's life, military campaigns, and contributions to early Islamic history. Some popular themes include strategies he used in battles, his loyalty to the Islamic prophet Muhammad, and his role as a uniter of various Arab tribes. The discussion around Busr's legacy is a way for users to explore and share their knowledge and appreciation for Islamic history and Arabic culture.
